I found it as a subfile under "Larval Borecrawlers, uses of."|A Rebel, posing as the "[[Peoples' Advisor]]," to the Rebel posing as the Rajah of Virujansi|<ref name="To Free the Forgotten">{{WEGCite|story=To Free the Forgotten|book=The Star Wars Rules Companion}}</ref>}}
'''Borecrawlers''' were creatures that lived in giant caves on [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. Larval Borecrawlers were used in the traditional executions of the deposed [[Rajah]]s.
